newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iran challenges U.S. mediation between Iraqi Kurds, affirms that Kurds have sought its help.
- Saudi Industrial Development Fund extends $16 million loan to the National Company for Glass Industries Co Ltd.
- Saudi Arabia is expected to increase production of water desalination to 800 million gallons per day in the five-year plan which started in 1995.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan's visit to Yemen will help boost bilateral relations. Prince Sultan is due in Sanaa on Wednesday.
- Yemeni President affirms his government's readiness to meet investors need.
- Kuwaiti Airways projects a 221 million Kuwaiti dinar income for the new 1996/97 fiscal year.
